parsed.reply: Hi! You can travel with a drone and lithium-ion batteries, but batteries must be protected from short circuit and damage. Fully drained batteries are generally allowed, but please check TSA rules and pack them in carry-on luggage. Let me know if you want more details!
parsed.grounding_used: I followed the pattern of providing concise info about lithium-ion battery rules and drone travel from similar historical replies.
